what: F1 step-7a.sh swallows the rebase checkpoint contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan moves rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh inside a quiet wrapper, continues into the pre-bump flush, and exits 0; the existing macro routes conflicts and failures from the probe process exit code plus stdout, so 7a.r conflict/failed rebase paths will not invoke conflict resolution or Step 18 bail routing before later flush work runs
suggested_fix: Keep 7a.r as a prompt-side foreground call, or split Step 7a into pre-rebase and post-rebase helpers; if the helper owns the probe, it must capture and re-emit the probe stdout, return the probe non-zero exit, and not run pre-bump flush until the macro has routed successfully

what: F2 sanitizer rejection detection keys off the wrong token shape
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says to suppress the diagrams upsert only when SKIP_REASON contains sanitizer-rejected/reject/sanitiz, but the current sanitizer emits concrete reason tokens such as pipe-in-node-label, br-in-participant-alias, dollar-in-participant-alias, and unclosed-frontmatter; those rejected diagrams would still be posted with a placeholder despite the proposed skip-upsert rule
suggested_fix: Treat STATUS=skipped from generate-code-flow-diagram.sh as sanitizer rejection, or have generate-code-flow-diagram.sh emit an explicit SANITIZER_REJECTED=true/REASON_CLASS=sanitizer-rejected field and test every current REASON_TOKEN fixture

what: F3 bootstrap depends on PLUGIN_ROOT before deriving it
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed bootstrap starts by sourcing "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib-quiet.sh" before defining PLUGIN_ROOT or recovering CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; under set -u this can fail before argv validation or session rehydration, which is exactly the path the helper is meant to support
suggested_fix: Follow the existing helper pattern: compute SCRIPT_DIR first, set PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd -P)}", then source lib-quiet.sh and proceed with session-key recovery

what: F4 new Makefile-only Step 7a harness pair is not added to agent-lint exclusions
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds skills/implement/scripts/test-step-7a.sh and test-step-7a.md, but only wires Makefile/docs; existing peer Makefile-only skill-local harnesses are explicitly excluded because agent-lint does not follow Makefile target chains, so make lint can fail on the new orphaned harness files
suggested_fix: Add skills/implement/scripts/test-step-7a.sh and skills/implement/scripts/test-step-7a.md to the existing skill-local test harness exclusion block in agent-lint.toml, or add another reachability path that agent-lint actually recognizes
